title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, 4.3 Maxima and Minima: Define absolute extrema.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, 4.3 Maxima and Minima: Define absolute extrema.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, section "4.3 Maxima and Minima", prints these objectives: "Define absolute extrema." "Define local extrema." "Explain how to find the critical points of a function over a closed interval." "Describe how to use critical points to locate absolute extrema over a closed interval.". The section text says: "Given a particular function, we are often interested in determining the largest and smallest values of the function. This information is important in creating accurate graphs. Finding the maximum and minimum values of a function also has practical significance because we can use this method to solve optimization problems, such as maximizing profit, minimizing the amount of material used in manufacturing an aluminum can, or finding the maximum height a rocket can reach. In this section, we look…" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
